newsitem.title: USA: Scios starts Phase III Natrecor trial.
newsitem.headline: Scios starts Phase III Natrecor trial.

text.p: Scios Inc said on Thursday it had started Phase III clinical studies of its Natrecor BNP drug for treating acute congestive heart failure.
The studies will include about 300 patients in about 50 centers in the United States.
Phase III studies are typically used as the basis of a filing for a drug's approval with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The Natrecor studies are designed to demonstrate the safety and efficacy of Natrecor in the short-term treatment of congestive heart failure, the company said.
Human BNP is a naturally-occurring hormone produced mainly in the ventricles of the heart.
Studies indicate that levels of BNP are elevated in states such as congestive heart failure, suggesting BNP may be a natural response to a failing heart, Scios said.
